issue.title: Add a vault-free Bob Mermaid checker and migrate research diagram validation
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1ml.2 note #1; approved epic plan plan:202610/research_swarm_mermaid_diagrams.md explicitly leaves this outside epic sase-1ml. The shipped research/diagrams macro at plugin commit da1c380 uses bob ref create <scratch>/check.md -o <scratch>/check_render.pdf -n -P <parent>; -P requires a Bob vault area/project despite a scratch-only validation. On 2026-10-18, bob ref diagrams --help exits 2: unrecognized subcommand diagrams. The accepted research design (file:explicit:cae0244aee50638db5d56447, Rollout and reopen conditions) also documents tall figures and a blank page under a heading without warnings. Open bob-cli through /sase_repo and plan a vault-free bob ref diagrams check <file.md> --json using its existing collector/renderer. Report per-diagram ok, error, width_pt, height_pt, scale; flag fitted height above about half the text box; fail nonzero on rendering failure; fit figures to text height minus a heading allowance. Once supported in a usable Bob release, migrate research/diagrams in sase-research-artifacts to it and remove the -P dependency, preserving fail-open behavior and verbatim validated sources. Size large because this requires planning the Bob CLI/render contract plus cross-project rollout. Duplicate searches across all task statuses, the past-week sweep, and active-epic scope review found no matching task or causally responsible active epic.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a vault-free Bob Mermaid validation CLI with structured per-diagram render and size results, then migrate the research diagram producer to it.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ml deliberately ships an already working scratch PDF validation command; the Bob CLI and page-fit changes are an optional follow-up in a separate project, not a defect caused by the epic. Proposed by sase-1ml.2 note #1.

issue.creation_reason: Preserve the explicit Bob validation follow-up from sase-1ml.2 note #1; the current producer requires a vault parent and lacks measured height diagnostics.
